remarks: H&B Due Monday April 14th at 12pm. Be prepared to be wowed by this turn key center hall colonial located on a quiet cul de sac in the desirable Mid Ridges area. This meticulously renovated home boasts modern upgrades and sleek finishes, delivering the perfect blend of style and functionality. State of the art eat in kitchen is flooded with natural light and features a spacious peninsula perfect for barstool seating, quartz counters, new st/st appliances, a pantry closet, and a separate wet bar/coffee bar area that leads out to a gorgeous covered 3 season patio perfect for hosting family and friends. Open concept layout flows from the living room into the dining room and finally through the kitchen into the family room w/renovated half bath. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite boasts a WIC & an en-suite bath with a walk in shower. 3 additional bedrooms and a modern full bath complete the second floor. Heated lower level offers exceptional space w/ an oversized room, perfect for a den, game room, gym w/ possibility to finish approx 300 more sq ft. Additional highlights include a one-car attached garage conveniently located off the family room, refinished hardwood flooring throughout, smart home color adjusting LED recessed lighting, additional storage in the basement and attic w/pull down stairs, whole house generator, beautifully landscaped grounds and private backyard.
